anomalies.observed: The anode pins of three indicator LEDs (D10 green, D35 yellow, D49 green) sit only on net /NET0148. No other pin is on that net, so the anodes have no supply connection. Their cathodes are driven by the active-low Ethernet/activity signals (Module2 pins 17, 21 and the R60/R85 paths).
anomalies.expected: Active-low status LEDs should have their anodes tied to a supply rail, normally +3V3, so they can light when the driver pulls the cathode low. Other indicator LEDs in this netlist, such as D39 and D16, are tied to a supply or driver output.
anomalies.impact: The Ethernet and activity indicator LEDs cannot conduct and will stay dark, so the board gives no link or activity indication. The logic-level signals are unaffected.

parsed.summary: The anode net of three status LEDs (D10, D35, D49) is isolated on /NET0148 with no supply connection, which looks like a missing tie to +3V3. The rest of the netlist and SPICE deck are consistent with the stated design, so this is the only deviation I could support with evidence.
